howto.text:
How to try it

• Press Play on the prototype, then click inside it once so it has the keys.
• Add: ⌥N (the browser keeps ⌘N), the + in the pane header, or click the empty space under a list's last task. Return adds and starts the next one. Esc drops an empty row.
• Rename: double-click a title, or select it and press Return. Lists too.
• Dates: select a task, ⌘S (When) or ⇧⌘D (Deadline), type tom, fri, 3d or nov 9, Return. Or click a chip.
• Drag rows to reorder, or onto a sidebar list to move them. Drag lists to reorder.
• Right-click rows and lists. ⌘Z undoes everything; delete, move and archive also show Undo.
• Press ? for every key.

qa_title.text: Pick one: how adding a task works

qa_note.text:
Each board starts mid-add. Click into the row (or the title in C), or press Esc and try ⌥N.

A · The new row appears where the task will land. Type, Return, type the next. Dates come after (⌘S, a chip, or the details).

B · The same row, and trailing date words become dates as you type: "fri", "tomorrow", "due nov 9". The chips light up before Return; the words leave the title.

C · ⌘N creates the task and opens it in the detail pane with the cursor in its title. Return moves to notes; Esc is done.

dp_title.text: Pick one: the date picker's shape

dp_note.text:
Both open from a chip, ⌘S or ⇧⌘D, and read the same words: tod, tom, fri, next fri, weekend, next week, 3d, 2w, nov 9, 11/9. ⌫ in an empty field clears the date.

A · Field, quick picks and the month. Typing moves the highlighted day, arrows nudge it, Return sets it.

B · A command-palette list that updates as you type; ↑↓ and Return. The month appears only when you ask for it.
